sections.title: Channels
sections.what: how channels, slots, fillers and the Quran channel are planned

fields.name: themes
fields.label: Themed channels
fields.help: One channel per theme, in priority order: its number, names, and the topics / audiences / formats / occasions whose shows it takes, and the tags it never takes (exclude, e.g. audience:adults). Min hours: this theme's own minimum instead of the days-without-a-repeat rule (the Quran channel repeats by nature); empty: the rule.

fields.name: dayparts
fields.label: Day parts
fields.help: The day's windows. Role: quran (recitation), high (the strongest shows first), low (the daypart's own topics first), block (a fixed block like the kids' hour: shows matching its topics first, in their order, never one with an exclude tag). Pattern: weekly (each day its own show), strip (one show every weekday), strip7 (every day), quran.

fields.name: max_channels
fields.label: Channels (most)
fields.help: At most this many channels in all. Candidates with enough content are taken in the kind order below: themes in their order, presenters largest first; the rest is listed as not placed.

fields.name: channel_kind_order
fields.label: Lineup order
fields.help: Which kinds of channel get the places first: quran, theme, mix, presenter. A kind left out gets no channel.

fields.name: channel_min_days
fields.label: Days without a repeat
fields.help: A channel needs enough content for this many days without a repeat (at the programme hours a day below); one with less gets no channel and its shows air on the others.

fields.name: channel_day_hours
fields.label: Programme hours a day
fields.help: How many hours of a channel's day are programmes (the rest is filler): with the days above, the hours a channel needs.

fields.name: library_tags
fields.label: Library tags
fields.help: Tags for every video of a library, by the library's exact name: audience:kids (made for children), audience:kids_friendly (fine for them), audience:adults (kept off the kids' channel and the kids' hour), or any topic tag.

fields.name: slot_owner
fields.label: A slot belongs to
fields.help: show: a slot keeps its show, then the shows left over. presenter: a slot is one sheikh's or source's (8 pm every day): his next show follows in the same slot, else one on the same topic.

fields.name: topic_min_score
fields.label: Topic match score
fields.help: A show belongs to a theme when its genre is one of the theme's topics, or its tag score for one reaches this.

fields.name: theme_min_hours
fields.label: Themed channel minimum (hours)
fields.help: A theme with fewer hours of shows gets no channel.

fields.name: theme_episodes
fields.label: Themes take single episodes
fields.help: A theme also takes the episodes whose own title is about it from every other show (a talk show's Palestine episodes, a tajweed lesson in a lecture series): one collection per presenter, in air order.

fields.name: theme_episode_min_count
fields.label: Single episodes per presenter (fewest)
fields.help: A presenter's collection for a theme needs at least this many episodes.

fields.name: mix_channel
fields.label: Mix channel
fields.help: A general channel mixing every genre.

fields.name: mix_exclude_topics
fields.label: Topics kept off the mix channel

fields.name: mix_daypart_topics
fields.label: Mix channel: topics per daypart
fields.help: The genres the mix channel prefers in each daypart (its key: morning, prime …). The prime list also counts towards a show's prime-time rank.

fields.name: presenter_channels
fields.label: Presenter channels
fields.help: A channel for each presenter with enough hours and genres.

fields.name: show_max_channels
fields.label: Channels per show (most)
fields.help: A show airs on at most this many channels (0: no limit), the closest first: the channel of its own topic before an audience or format channel (History before Kids, Palestine before Talk Shows), then the one with fewer hours. Wherever it airs, never at the same time on two channels. A channel left without enough content of its own drops out.

fields.name: show_same_time
fields.label: Same show, same time on two channels
fields.help: Off: a show on more than one channel always airs at different times (8 pm here, 6 pm there), its repeats too.

fields.name: presenter_max_channels
fields.label: Presenter channels (most)
fields.help: Only the largest libraries get a channel of their own; the others air on the theme channels.

fields.name: short_series_max_minutes
fields.label: Series shorter than this are filler (min)

fields.name: loose_programs
fields.label: Stand-alone videos as programmes
fields.help: Long videos in no series become programmes, grouped by topic.

fields.name: generic_filler_topics
fields.label: General filler topics
fields.help: The library's general filler, used after a slot's own and the channel's.

fields.name: recitation_genres
fields.label: Recitation genres
fields.help: Seasons of these genres are recitation (the Quran lanes and channel); tajweed lessons are not, they air on Quran Learning.

fields.name: dawn_quran
fields.label: Quran at dawn
fields.help: The quran dayparts play the library's Quran recitation on every channel.

fields.name: khutbah_only_friday
fields.label: Khutbahs only in their slot
fields.help: Khutbah seasons leave the regular shows.

fields.name: ramadan_grid
fields.label: Ramadan schedule
fields.help: Channels with Ramadan shows get a second grid for Ramadan.

fields.name: slot_round_minutes
fields.label: Slot step (min)
fields.help: Slot lengths are rounded up to this.

fields.name: overrun_tolerance_minutes
fields.label: Overrun allowed (min)
fields.help: An episode this much longer than its slot still gets the slot.

fields.name: weekend_days
fields.label: Weekend days
fields.help: Strip shows air on the other days; weekly shows take these (mon … sun).

fields.name: cadence_min_gaps
fields.label: Exact dates needed
fields.help: How many exact air dates a show needs before its own rhythm (daily or weekly) is used.

fields.name: strip_max_gap_days
fields.label: Daily if the gap is at most (days)

fields.name: weekly_formats
fields.label: Weekly formats
fields.help: Shows of these formats air once a week.

fields.name: strip_formats
fields.label: Daily formats
fields.help: Shows of these formats air every weekday.

fields.name: strip_max_limited_episodes
fields.label: Short series air daily (episodes)
fields.help: A limited series with at most this many episodes airs every weekday.

fields.name: extra_airings
fields.label: Extra airings
fields.help: A channel with fewer shows than slots repeats its shows. Off: the rest of the week is filler.

fields.name: show_member_min_share
fields.label: Whole show share
fields.help: A show joins a channel whole (all its years) when this share of its hours matches the channel.

fields.name: fill_target
fields.label: Fill target
fields.help: When a channel's shows fill less than this share of its week, its biggest weekly shows move to daily strips first.

fields.name: extra_min_weeks_left
fields.label: Extra airings keep (weeks)
fields.help: An extra airing never brings a slot under this many weeks of episodes.

fields.name: filler_between_episodes
fields.label: Filler between episodes
fields.help: Pad between the episodes of a long block too, not only at its end.

fields.name: slot_filler_topics
fields.label: Slot filler topics
fields.help: A slot's own filler matches its shows' first N topics.

fields.name: quran_rotation
fields.label: Reciter rotation
fields.help: by_day: a reciter (or a few) per day; by_time: reciters change every few hours.

fields.name: quran_time_rules
fields.label: Styles at set times
fields.help: A style plays at these hours every day, rotating among its reciters (mujawwad after Fajr, warsh at night).

fields.name: quran_library_min_share
fields.label: Reciter library share
fields.help: A library is a reciter's when this share of its hours is recitation. Only those feed the Quran channel and Quran at dawn.

fields.name: quran_fallback_any_recitation
fields.label: No reciter library: use any recitation
fields.help: When no library reaches the share, the library's recitations still make the Quran lanes. Off: no Quran lane then.

fields.name: quran_styles
fields.label: Recitation styles
fields.help: The words that name each style in a reciter's library or season names; the first match wins.

fields.name: quran_max_reciters_per_day
fields.label: Reciters per day (most)
fields.help: More reciters than days split each day into up to this many parts.

fields.name: quran_filler_exclude_formats
fields.label: Formats never filler on the Quran channel

fields.name: prime_unknown_formats
fields.label: Formats ranked like produced shows
fields.help: When a show's production style is unknown.

fields.name: rank_collection_bonus
fields.label: Bonus: lecture collection
fields.help: Usually negative.

fields.name: rank_style_bonus
fields.label: Bonus: produced style
fields.help: Production style is only a tie-breaker.

fields.name: timezone
fields.label: Time zone
fields.help: IANA name (Asia/Riyadh); empty: the server's.

fields.name: dz_filler_max_items
fields.label: Filler list size (most clips)
fields.help: A dizqueTV filler list holds the first this many clips of its pool (own promos, then on-topic clips). dizqueTV takes at most 50 MB per request.

fields.name: dz_logo_dir
fields.label: Channel logos folder
fields.help: The guide's channel logos: <channel key>.png (quran.png, kids.png …), else default.png. Uploaded to dizqueTV with the channels. Empty: none.

fields.name: dz_watermark_file
fields.label: Corner logo (watermark)
fields.help: A picture shown in a corner of the video on every channel, like a TV station's logo; an animated GIF loops. Empty: none.

fields.name: dz_watermark_width
fields.label: Corner logo width (% of the picture)

fields.name: dz_watermark_margin
fields.label: Corner logo margin (% from the edges)

fields.name: dz_art_url
fields.label: Logos web address
fields.help: Where the logos are served from, e.g. a Cloudflare R2 or Pages address: the files sit there under their own names (…/quran.png, …/watermark.gif) and are checked before use. Empty: uploaded to dizqueTV and served by it.

fields.name: dz_public_url
fields.label: dizqueTV address on the network
fields.help: How the TVs and Plex reach dizqueTV, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8002 or a Tailscale address; used for the links of logos dizqueTV serves. Empty: the address the export uses (localhost works on this PC only).

sections.title: Grouping
sections.what: clip and stand-alone collections, promos, questions and fatwas

fields.name: filler_max_minutes
fields.label: Clip up to (min)
fields.help: Longer leftovers are stand-alone programmes (منفردات), shorter ones clips (filler).

fields.name: qa_phrases
fields.label: Question / fatwa phrases
fields.help: A title with one of these goes to "فتاوى ومسائل". A phrase matches the start of a word (ما رأي → ما رأيك); end it with a space to match it only as a whole word ("حكم " is not حكمة).

fields.name: promo_words
fields.label: Promo words
fields.help: A title with one of these advertises a show; it is linked to the show it names.

sections.title: Detection
sections.what: how shows, seasons and talk shows are found

fields.name: generic_words
fields.label: Words that never name a show
fields.help: Ignored when a show's name is read from titles (the presenter's and channel's words are added).

fields.name: clip_playlist_re
fields.label: Clip playlists (pattern)
fields.help: A playlist whose title matches holds clips, never a show's episodes.

fields.name: catch_all_re
fields.label: Catch-all playlists (pattern)
fields.help: "All videos", "منوعات": never a show once this big.

fields.name: core_band
fields.label: Episode length band
fields.help: A season's videos farther than this factor from its usual length are extras.

fields.name: same_show_ratio
fields.label: Same show length ratio
fields.help: Two playlists of one name are one show only if their usual lengths are this close.

fields.name: short_form_s
fields.label: Promo length (s)
fields.help: Shorter extras count as promos.

fields.name: attach_threshold
fields.label: Match score
fields.help: A video in no playlist joins a season from this score.

fields.name: ongoing_month_coverage
fields.label: Ongoing month coverage
fields.help: The share of months in the span with an episode.

fields.name: min_episode_s
fields.label: Shortest episode (s)
fields.help: Anything shorter is a short or a clip, never an episode.

fields.name: brand_min
fields.label: Talk show from (videos)
fields.help: A title part (شاهد على العصر |) carried by at least this many videos names a show.

fields.name: brand_share
fields.label: Talk show share of the channel

fields.name: brand_named_share
fields.label: Rebuild below this share in its own series

fields.name: topic_min
fields.label: Topic collection from (videos)
fields.help: A curated playlist cutting across shows (الشأن الفلسطيني) becomes a topic collection.

sections.title: Tagging
sections.what: topic, format, audience and occasion tags, and what transcripts add to them

fields.name: w_name
fields.label: Series name weight
fields.help: How much the series' own name counts.

fields.name: w_episodes
fields.label: Episode titles weight
fields.help: Times the share of episode titles naming a topic.

fields.name: w_description
fields.label: Description weight
fields.help: Only a description's opening counts.

fields.name: w_channel
fields.label: Channel weight
fields.help: A prior: a reciter's channel leans everything to recitation.

fields.name: w_title
fields.label: Video title weight
fields.help: For a video in no season.

fields.name: min_score
fields.label: Lowest tag score
fields.help: Weaker tags are dropped (0 to 1).

fields.name: clip_max_s
fields.label: Clip up to (s)
fields.help: A shorter season median or video is clip-like.

fields.name: long_form_s
fields.label: Long-form from (s)
fields.help: Long videos naming no format are lectures.

fields.name: occasion_share
fields.label: Occasion share
fields.help: The share of exact air dates in Ramadan / Dhu al-Hijjah that makes a season seasonal.

fields.name: program_min_episodes
fields.label: Broadcast program from (episodes)
fields.help: A season airing this many episodes within the window below is a program.

fields.name: w_transcript
fields.label: Transcript weight
fields.help: Times the share of transcripts that talk about a topic. Below the titles: speech is noisy and talks wander.

fields.name: transcript_max_minutes
fields.label: Read the first (min)
fields.help: Only the opening of each transcript is read.

fields.name: transcript_max_episodes
fields.label: Transcripts per season
fields.help: A bigger season is judged on this many transcripts, spread over its episodes.

fields.name: transcript_namespaces
fields.label: Tag kinds from speech
fields.help: topic, format, audience, occasion: which kinds of tag a transcript may give.

fields.name: transcript_min_weight
fields.label: Lightest phrase in speech
fields.help: Weaker lexicon phrases (النبي, القلب) never count in a transcript.

fields.name: transcript_single_word_weight
fields.label: Single words in speech from
fields.help: A one-word phrase counts only from this weight (السيرة, تفسير); lighter evidence must be a phrase of several words (غزوة بدر).

fields.name: transcript_full_strength
fields.label: Mentions for full evidence
fields.help: The summed phrase weight in one transcript that makes it full evidence.

fields.name: transcript_stop_phrases
fields.label: Formulas to ignore
fields.help: Said in every talk; never evidence of a topic.

fields.name: w_transcript_recitation
fields.label: Recitation weight
fields.help: Times the share of transcripts that sound recited (Quran text, no commentary).

fields.name: recitation_min_words
fields.label: Judge from (words)
fields.help: Shorter transcripts are never called recited.

fields.name: recitation_max_commentary
fields.label: Commentary words per 100, at most
fields.help: More than this and it is a talk quoting verses, not a recitation.

fields.name: recitation_min_quranic_share
fields.label: Quranic word share, at least
fields.help: The share of words typical of the Quran.

fields.name: recitation_commentary_words
fields.label: Commentary words
fields.help: Words a speaker says and the Quran does not: fillers, addresses to the audience, the khutbah opening, hadith citations. Whole words.

fields.name: recitation_quranic_words
fields.label: Quranic words
fields.help: Words frequent in the Quran's text (prefixes و ف ب ل allowed).
